cve_details.description:
VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service.
Affected versions: 9.1.x (fixed in 9.1.1.0200); 9.0.x (fixed in 9.0.2.0200); 8.0 (fixed in 8.0 U3m); 5.x (fixed in 5.2.5).
Telco Cloud Platform 3.0, 4.x, 5.0.x, 5.1.x, 5.2 and Telco Cloud Infrastructure 3.0 are also affected (see KB463116).

alerts.title: N-able Discloses Critical Mail Assure Vulnerability Found During Breach Investigation

cve_details.description: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) before 20261121.1943 does not restrict the destination of the LDAP synchronisation connection check performed when a relay is configured. An authenticated API user can cause the server to connect to arbitrary internal hosts and ports, determine which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services.
